notes.title: A New Challenge Awaits: Demo Now Available!
notes.notes: [p]To celebrate Next Fest, we're giving you a teaser of our one-button-action-platformer, set to release very soon. We've put a lot of love into the Steam version and hope you enjoy this curated selection of content.[/p][p][/p][p]What’s waiting for you in the demo? [/p][olist][*][p]26 Challenges - A selection of challenges from across the game[/p][/*][*][p]15 Co-Op Challenges - Play locally with your friends (1-4 players)[/p][/*][*][p]Circuit Score Chaser Mode - One of the two score chasing game modes available in the full game[/p][/*][*][p]We've also included 3 pixel themes and a number of player avatars to give you a feel for whats available [/p][/*][/olist][p][/p][p] What's available in the full release?[/p][list][*][p] Over 150 challenge levels [/p][/*][*][p] Modifiers for all the challenge levels, for those who want an even tougher challenge[/p][/*][*][p] Endless score chaser mode + two-player competitive score chaser mode[/p][/*][*][p] 80 co-op challenges (2-4 player local co-op)[/p][/*][*][p] 10 pixel art themes from guest artists[/p][/*][*][p] Workshop support - User created challenge levels & custom pixel themes[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]We hope you give it a go, and look forward to hearing your comments and feedback! [/p]
